verdict.rationale: E2B documents two narrow bulk operations of its own. The CLI can shut down all running sandboxes in one command, and the SDK can write multiple files to a sandbox in one call. Beyond these, there is no general batch mechanism across many items. missing for 10: bulk command execution or batch creation across many sandboxes, bulk pause/resume or timeout changes, a documented batch API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
